name: DeleteColumnFromExcelWorksheet
label: Delete Column from Excel Worksheet
description: Deletes a specific column from the specified Excel worksheet instance.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object from which the column will be deleted.

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: The index (1-based) or letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') of the column to delete.
